interest: Shows the National Foreign Trade Council seeking wartime Japanese industrial-property laws from State, with records consulted into the 1960s.
overview: File 894.541: Vernon's 1948 letter sends the NFTC translations of Japan's 1917 and 1943 wartime industrial property laws; a later charge-out sheet records the loan of related Tokyo despatches and FEC files in 1960 and 1962.
